answers.q1: pip with a venv, driven by the repo's scripts (no uv/poetry). Install with: scripts/install (creates ./venv with python3 -m venv, then runs pip install -U pip and pip install -r requirements.txt). To use a specific interpreter: scripts/install -p python3.12
answers.q2: scripts/test (this runs scripts/check first, then 'coverage run -m pytest', then scripts/coverage, which fails if coverage is under 100%). To run pytest alone without the lint and coverage gates: venv/bin/pytest
answers.q3: venv/bin/pytest tests/client/test_auth.py (or, if the venv is already activated, pytest tests/client/test_auth.py). Using the wrapper instead: scripts/test tests/client/test_auth.py. The wrapper also runs scripts/check first and then the coverage gate, which will fail on a partial run.
answers.q4: scripts/check. This is what CI runs in its 'Run linting checks' step, and it runs these commands: ./scripts/sync-version; venv/bin/ruff format httpx tests --diff; venv/bin/mypy httpx tests; venv/bin/ruff check httpx tests. CI also runs scripts/build and scripts/coverage as separate steps. To auto-fix instead of just check, run scripts/lint.
answers.q5: None are committed. The repo has no vendored or generated source files that must not be edited by hand, and httpx/_status_codes.py is ordinary source. The only generated directories are git-ignored build outputs: venv*/, build/, dist/, site/ (mkdocs output), htmlcov/, .coverage, *.egg-info/, .mypy_cache/, .pytest_cache/ and __pycache__/. httpx/__version__.py is hand-edited but must match the latest CHANGELOG.md entry (checked by scripts/sync-version).
